system.description: You believe deeply that medical ninja do not belong on the front lines and so did your master or mentor. Beginning at 7th level, you embody this philosophy and do everything in your power to live this truth. Whenever you are within 10 feet of a hostile creature, you can take the dash or disengage actions as a bonus action. Beginning at 15th level, you can take the Dodge action as a bonus action as well.
